en: Bonjour! How are you doing? From Paris!
zh: （法语）嗨，你好吗？来自巴黎的问候！（*这段视频连读吞音过于严重了，所以听不清不是你的问题！）

en: Let the Paris Diaries begin!
zh: 让巴黎日记开始吧！

en: I've been here for a couple days just kind of settling in.
zh: 我已经在这里住了几天，刚刚适应这里的环境。

en: I honestly haven't really gotten out much but it's honestly been pretty grey and gloomy.
zh: 老实说，我还真没怎么出门，但天气确实灰蒙蒙的。

en: But the sun is finally out today so I think we need to do some exploring.
zh: 但是今天太阳终于出来了，所以我想我们需要去探索一番。

en: And I'm obviously only just getting settled but it feels really good being here so far.
zh: 显然，我才刚刚安顿下来，但到目前为止，在这里的感觉真的很好。

en: It's nice to reconnect with some people that I met in the fall
zh: 很高兴能与我在秋季认识的一些人重新建立联系

en: and my French is still absolutely horrible but I can understand a lot more than last time.
zh: 我的法语仍然非常糟糕，但我现在懂得比上次更多了。

en: which is a great feeling that like some of my studying is actually paying off.
zh: 这让我觉得很好，就是我的一些学习确实得到了回报。

en: I think I must be the world's slowest language learner.
zh: 我想我一定是世界上学习语言最慢的人。

en: I don't know how some of you guys learn a language in like 3 to 4 months.
zh: 我不知道你们有些人是如何在三四个月内学会一门语言的。

en: Even like 6 months I'm like something about my brain, the language element on there.
zh: 即使是 6 个月，我也觉得我的大脑里面，管语言的那块。

en: It's not clicked quickly for me. I wish it did.
zh: 对我来说就开窍很慢。我希望我的脑子能给点力。

en: I will say I've mostly been spending some of my time alone just kind of working and enjoying new little routines.
zh: 我想说的是，我大部分时间都在独自工作和享受新的小惯例

en: Pitter pattering around the apartment.
zh: 在公寓里鼓捣鼓捣东西。

en: I love my little introverted time and doing my own thing.
zh: 我喜欢我的独处时光，喜欢做自己的事情。

en: I feel like I just always end up doing a lot more when there's a friend to do it with.
zh: 我觉得如果有朋友一起做，我会做得更多。

en: Because the social anxiety of being like where do I sit in this café or restaurant like
zh: 因为社交焦虑比如像我在咖啡馆或餐厅里该坐在哪里一样。

en: completely diminishes when you're with somebody in my case.
zh: 就我而言，当你和某人在一起时，这种感觉就会完全消失。

en: Whereas when I'm by myself just like social anxiety is an all time high but we do it anyways.
zh: 而当我一个人的时候，社交焦虑就会达到前所未有的高度，但我们还是会去做。

en: All that aside because the weather is good we have to go make the most of the day and see Paris.
zh: 撇开这些不谈，因为天气很好，我们必须充分利用这一天去看看巴黎。

en: Gotta do a little OOTD before I head out.
zh: 出门之前，我得来一个一个小小的 OOTD。

en: My outfits are going to be very repetitive because I just only have two suitcases for like the next like 7 months of my life.
zh: 我的服装会非常重复，因为我只有两个行李箱，就像接下来的 7 个月

en: We have Source Unknown, Bonnie and Clyde, Princess Mango, got my wide leg pants, Vagabond
zh: 我们有 Source Unknown, Bonnie and Clyde, Princess Mango, 阔腿裤, Vagabond。

en: and we're ready.
zh: 准备好了
